 Job Title: 
 Intern | Income Tax Laws | Bengaluru | Business Tax
Graduate - B.Com/ BBM and has a basic understanding of US Individual tax returns - Form 1040 
 JD 
The candidates should have prior experience in preparation/ review of Form 1040 (the US individual tax return form) – unless the candidate is a graduate/ fresher with no prior experience 
The experience should include – reviewing underlying documentation, requesting pending documentation, identifying discrepancies, if any and filling the data in the format required in the Form 1040 and tax computation knowledge 
Candidates should have a minimum of a Bachelors degree – large population will have a finance and tax specialization but we may also come across a micro population of BTech grads who chose this career path for themselves and have undergone US tax training and education with institutes in India 
Certain candidates may be Enrolled agents or CPAs – these are credentialized candidates with US tax education who will generally be placed in the 4+ category or 5+ years category 
 Location - Gurgram (including Delhi is fine)/ Hyderabad 
 Work mode - Work from office only (due to data security and confidentiality requirements from clients)

 Job Title: 
 Intern | Not Applicable | Mumbai | Talent
About the Role 
As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you will support the recruitment team in managing end-to-end hiring activities across multiple business functions. This internship provides hands-on exposure to corporate recruitment, stakeholder management, candidate engagement, and recruitment operations. 
Key Responsibilities 
Support the Talent Acquisition team in sourcing and screening candidate profiles. 
Coordinate interviews with candidates, hiring managers, and interview panels. 
Schedule interviews and manage interview logistics. 
Track candidate progress through the recruitment lifecycle and maintain accurate records in recruitment systems. 
Engage with candidates through email and phone for interview scheduling and follow-ups. 
Support campus hiring, walk-in drives, and recruitment events, as required. 
Maintain recruitment dashboards, and hiring trackers using Excel. 
Ensure timely documentation and maintain data accuracy throughout the hiring process. 
Coordinate with internal stakeholders to facilitate a seamless recruitment experience.
